text: better-dsh-session-deletetool 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话管理插件：它在会话菜单和工作区界面加入删除入口，并由 Host 路由读取会话关系、执行删除。用户可以查看主会话、子智能体和派生对话组成的家族树，选择删除单个会话或批量处理多个会话；批量列表支持搜索、排序、类型与工作区筛选及分页。界面还显示会话自身和家族 Token 用量、缓存命中情况，并提供会话目录与 DSH 缓存目录的打开入口。适合需要清理 DSH 会话并先检查会话关联和用量的用户。插件不要求 API Key 或外部账号；需在 DSH Web 环境使用，打开目录时调用本机文件管理器。

better-dsh-session-deletetool manages DSH Web sessions. Its menu and workspace panel show conversation families for single or bulk deletion. Users can search, sort, filter, and page through sessions, view token usage, and open session or cache folders. No API key or account is needed.
怎么把 DSH 里不需要的会话连同日志真正删掉？
我想先看清一个对话带出的子智能体和派生会话，再决定删哪些。
能不能在工作区里一次挑选多个会话清理？
我需要按工作区或会话类型筛选，再批量删除旧对话。
想比较各个会话的 Token 用量和缓存命中情况后再做整理。
怎么从 DSH 界面打开某个会话对应的本地文件夹？
How can I permanently remove DSH conversations after checking their related sessions?
I need a bulk session manager with family selection, filters, and token usage figures.
better-dsh-session-deletetool 的功能「会话家族删除」：在会话菜单打开家族树，查看子智能体与派生对话并勾选要删除的节点；Host 校验所选后代属于该家族，并按由深到浅顺序移除。
better-dsh-session-deletetool 的功能「批量会话管理」：打开工作区批量面板后，可搜索会话、按最近活动或 Token 与命中率排序，按类型和工作区筛选、分页并选择会话；确认后逐项提交删除。
better-dsh-session-deletetool 的功能「会话用量摘要」：检查或浏览会话时，Host 从 DSH 会话日志折叠输入、缓存读取、缓存写入和输出 Token，并计算会话及家族汇总；Client 用数字和分段条展示。
better-dsh-session-deletetool 的功能「打开会话目录」：家族树或批量列表中的目录按钮按会话 ID 请求 Host；Host 通过持久化服务定位会话目录，再调用操作系统文件管理器打开。
better-dsh-session-deletetool 的功能「关闭用量读取」：用户切换用量显示后，Client 在读取目录时附带 usage 参数；关闭时 Host 不折叠会话日志，并在界面显示用量已关闭。

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · better-dsh-session-deletetool：**Delete a DeepSeek Harness conversation for real, and manage the whole family around it.**

DSH ships archive only. This plugin adds a real delete — session log, Workspace account, archive/pin
membership and projection-cache record — and surrounds it with the numbers and folders you need to
decide what to remove.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md)

---

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · What it adds：- **Real delete.** The log directory goes, the Workspace record forgets the session, archive and pin
  membership are cleared, and the projection-cache record is dropped. DSH's own archive only hides.
- **The conversation family, as a tree.** A main conversation, its forked conversations and its
  subagents, nested by `parentSession` — a subagent that spawned its own subagent sits one level
  deeper. In the single dialog a parent click selects only that node (blank until it is selected,
  then green, yellow or red for itself / some descendants / the whole family), and the top
  Select all box takes the whole family.
- **Usage per conversation.** A node counts only the requests it made itself. A parent also shows
  `own/family`, the family total after a slash.
- **Three-way token bar.** Cache-hit input (green), cache-miss input (blue), output (yellow), with the
  three percentages underneath. Cache hit rate = hit / (hit + miss + write).
- **Fork-aware counting.** A forked conversation's inherited log prefix is skipped, and requests are
  de-duplicated by message id, so a fork never re-counts its parent's past.
- **Local folders.**

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · Install：All routes go through DSH's plugin manager:

```bash
npm install better-dsh-session-deletetool
```

- GitHub: `plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "github:Lzcdebear/better-dsh-session-deletetool" }`
- Local copy: `plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "<absolute path to the unpacked folder>" }`
- Tarball: `https://github.com/Lzcdebear/better-dsh-session-deletetool/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz`

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · Install：Refresh the page after installing. Changes to the Host half need a full restart of DSH.

To remove: `plugin_manager { action: "remove_bundle", target: "better-dsh-session-deletetool" }`.

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · Usage：**One conversation.** Open a session's `⋯` menu and pick **Delete conversation**. The dialog shows the
family tree, that conversation's own usage and family total, the cache split, and a folder button on
every row.

**Bulk.** Press the trash control in the Workspace header, left of the search icon. Each family is a
card; tick rows, filter, sort, page, then delete the selection or every conversation.

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · Usage：Before deleting, the Host asks DSH's own activity admission. Running work is reported; it is stopped
only after you confirm.

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · HTTP surface：| Route | Method | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/inspect?sessionId=…` | GET | state, family rows, usage and folder per node |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/delete` | POST | `{ sessionId, stop?, descendants? }` |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/catalog` | GET | every session with usage and folder, plus a corpus summary |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/delete-batch` | POST | `{ roots: [{ sessionId, descendants? }], stop?, cleanCache? }` |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/open-directory` | POST | `{ sessionId }` — open that session's folder |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/open-cache` | POST | open DSH's projection-cache folder |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/refresh-stats` | POST | drop the plugin's cached usage folds |
better-dsh-session-deletetool README · HTTP surface：Every route carries a loopback and same-origin gate, so another page cannot reach them.

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · Layout：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `host.js` | Host half: the routes, removal, family walk, catalog and corpus totals |
| `session-model.js` | Usage folding, directory resolution, cache invalidation |
| `client.js` | Client half: the menu row, the bulk control, and the two dialogs |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the Host row into the profile's layer stack |
| `test/host.test.mjs` | Route tests over real temporary directories |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin artwork |

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · Layout：Styles use host theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`) only, so light and dark both read; the UI is localized
(English / 简体中文) through the Client locale service.

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · Known limits：- Fork lineage is read from `inheritedEventCount`. This build has no fork sample, so that path follows
  the field's meaning but has not been exercised against real data.
- A session whose folder the backend cannot locate keeps its folder button disabled, with the reason
  in its tooltip.
- Usage is folded from each log on first read; later reads reuse a size + mtime cache. About ninety
  sessions fold in under a second on this machine.

node --test test/host.test.mjs

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · better-dsh-session-deletetool：**在 DeepSeek Harness 里真正删除一个会话，并管理它带出的整个家族。**

DSH 自带的只有归档。这个插件补上删除：会话日志目录、工作区记录、归档与置顶成员、投影缓存记录一起清掉，同时把判断要删什么的用量与目录摆在眼前。

[English](README.md)

---

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · 功能：- **真删除。** 删除会话自己的日志目录，从工作区记录里移除，清掉归档与置顶成员，再删投影缓存记录。DSH 原生只有归档。
- **会话家族树。** 主会话、它的 Fork 子会话与子智能体，按 `parentSession` 逐层嵌套；子智能体再派生的子智能体自然更深一层。单会话窗口里单击父节点只选它自己（未选中为空白，选中后按后代显示绿 / 黄 / 红），整个家族用顶部全选。
- **每个会话的用量。** 一个节点只统计它自己发起的请求。主会话额外显示“自身/家族”，斜杠后是整个家族的合计。
- **三色 Token 条。** 缓存命中输入（绿）、缓存未命中输入（蓝）、输出（黄），下面列三条百分比。缓存命中率 = 命中 ÷（命中 + 未命中 + 写缓存）。
- **Fork 去重。** Fork 子会话继承的日志前缀会被跳过，请求再按消息 id 去重，不会把父会话过去的消耗重复计到子会话头上。
- **本地目录。** 每行右侧的文件夹按钮打开该节点自己的目录。路径由 Host 通过 `sessionPersistence.locate` 解析，不按会话名拼路径。
- **批量管理。** 每个家族一张卡片，支持按名称搜索、按最后活跃 / Token / 命中率排序、按类型与工作区筛选、分页、本页全选、删除选中，以及二次确认后的删除全部。
- **缓存控制。** 可以打开 DSH 的投影缓存目录，操作栏下方会说明这个目录是什么。
- **用量开关。** 关掉后 Host 不再读取会话日志，Token 与命中率的位置显示“已关闭”。

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · 安装：四种方式都走 DSH 的插件管理器：

```bash
npm install better-dsh-session-deletetool
```

- GitHub：`plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "github:Lzcdebear/better-dsh-session-deletetool" }`
- 本地副本：`plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "<解压后的绝对路径>" }`
- 发布包：`https://github.com/Lzcdebear/better-dsh-session-deletetool/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz`

安装后刷新页面。改动 Host 侧需要完全重启 DSH。

卸载：`plugin_manager { action: "remove_bundle", target: "better-dsh-session-deletetool" }`。

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · 用法：**单个会话。** 在会话的 `⋯` 菜单里选「删除会话」。对话框会画出家族树，显示这个会话自身的用量与家族合计、缓存分布，每一行都有文件夹按钮。

**批量。** 点工作区标题栏里的垃圾桶图标（在搜索图标左侧）。每个家族是一张卡片，可以勾选、筛选、排序、翻页，然后删除选中或删除全部。

删除前会先问 DSH 自己的活动准入：有正在运行的工作会先提示，确认后才停掉。

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · HTTP 接口：| 路由 | 方法 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/inspect?sessionId=…` | GET | 状态、家族行、每行用量与目录 |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/delete` | POST | `{ sessionId, stop?, descendants? }` |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/catalog` | GET | 全部会话及用量与目录，附全局汇总 |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/delete-batch` | POST | `{ roots: [{ sessionId, descendants? }], stop?, cleanCache? }` |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/open-directory` | POST | `{ sessionId }`，打开该会话目录 |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/open-cache` | POST | 打开 DSH 的投影缓存目录 |
| `/better-dsh-session-deletetool/refresh-stats` | POST | 清空插件的用量缓存 |
better-dsh-session-deletetool README · HTTP 接口：所有路由都带回环与同源校验，别的页面访问不到。

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · 构成：| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `host.js` | Host 侧：路由、删除、家族遍历、清单与全局汇总 |
| `session-model.js` | 用量折叠、目录解析、缓存失效 |
| `client.js` | Client 侧：菜单项、批量入口、两个对话框 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 把 Host 行插进 profile 的层级栈 |
| `test/host.test.mjs` | 基于真实临时目录的路由测试 |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |

样式只用宿主主题 token（`--dsw-alias-*`），明暗主题都能读；界面通过 Client locale 服务支持中英文。

better-dsh-session-deletetool README · 已知边界：- Fork 的血缘读自 `inheritedEventCount`。当前构建里没有 Fork 样本，这条路径按字段语义实现，尚未在真实数据上验证。
- 持久化后端定位不到目录的会话，文件夹按钮保持禁用，提示里写明原因。
- 用量在首次读取时从日志折叠，之后复用“大小 + 修改时间”缓存。本机约九十个会话全量折叠不到一秒。
